name: Trust Your Food
tagline: Farmers list produce by talking; consumers shop with AI; orders are delivered on optimised group routes.

awards: [MLH] Best Domain Name from GoDaddy Registry

problem: Small farms struggle to reach customers directly, the builder says from experience.
solution: A voice agent lets farmers list by phone; AI helps consumers shop; deliveries are batched through a delivery API.
demo_moment: Team-described: a farmer lists eggs by voice and a buyer orders them.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Domain Name from GoDaddy Registry” among 212 submissions.
Removes the tech barrier for farmers.

lessons: Solve both sides of a marketplace differently.
